title: Set up log/slog and direct logrus output to it
body:
Per earlier discussion in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2958 :

This allows us to start using `log/slog` calls, both here and in container-libs.

Smoke-tested by adding a few logging calls (of both kinds) to `version.go`; I didn't test logging from the various subprocesses.

Buildah exposes an API that lets callers use custom `logrus.Logger` destinations; that is unchanged by this. This API does not affect other code like container-libs, so it can be migrated independently if desired.

comments.body: Ephemeral COPR build failed. @containers/packit-build please check.

> LGTM Note to self: this makes changes to global configuration only in main() or reexec initializers.

Note also the `log.SetOutput` in `GenBuildOptions` — and yes, it’s really `log`:
- `slog`’s default output formatter directs output through `log`, so this should work as expected
- `slog`’s default formatter, writing through `log`, is not exposed as a public API; `slog.TextFormatter` uses heavier output syntax. So, not touching `slog.SetDefault` and affecting the `log` destination is the only way to keep the simpler output

Will this change the ouput of the logs that the end user will see?  Slightly concerned that if someone has set a script up to look for something that's no longer there, things might go badly for them.

Code changes LGTM.  Tests aren't hip, I'll restart.

If we have a log output change, we probably should add a release note.

And I'm not restarting the tests.  I think there may be log output changes that are gumming up the works.
